review: Thumbnail: allocation, scope, figure/ground and missing principal color families.
Native pixels: exact named owner, surface boundary, pattern topology, light footprint or material appearance required by the actual selected contract.
Record every attempt and all required gate IDs; missing, merged, swapped or ambiguous required evidence fails under partial_is_fail.
Judge visible state only; material chemistry, production history, psychological effect, legal compliance and data truth need separate evidence.
Where exact colors matter, record ICC/output space, exposure/white-balance and masks of representative surfaces. Photographic shading is not a flat-chip byte match.
Blind reviewers to arm labels where practical. Report actual n and failures; a single attractive output or zero optional adoption proves no improvement.
Record requesting-user preference separately; no synthetic acceptance in product evidence.
